requiredMainWitnesses.missing: An authorized complete actual stone lot and mithril output specification: exact mass,composition/purity/phase,geometry and governing density or explicit physical mapping,durability where relevant,fit/support/containment,custody/origin; plus actual exact compatible recipe intake or a finite buyer/quote/funds. Then a legal paid26RP Action conversion with full resource/clock and lot lineage.
requiredMainWitnesses.sourceFactsAlreadyPresent: Native stone-to-mithril and value250gp/lb; current recipe catalog and separate ingredient identities; actual Wizard17 learned/prepared route.
requiredMainWitnesses.notInferred: No price-derived density,automaticBrightsteel/Mithralalias,currency minting,monster provenance,market proceeds or free finished magic item.

requiredMainWitnesses.missing: A second specified damaged structural/material input and output with actual dimensions,material durability,ownership,support/containment and competing reservation history; demonstrate committed conversion or paid adverse failure with conservation,remainder/disposition,no free repair and completed-result permanence.
requiredMainWitnesses.sourceFactsAlreadyPresent: Atomic transaction,source qualification and preservation contracts are proposed; broad equipment durability rules do not alone instantiate this target structure.
requiredMainWitnesses.traceGap: MF210-M-reserved-lot and MF210-M-late-fit are one-event conditional deltas; they have no paid caster,competing cast/custody ledger or source-qualified structural conversion.

blockerEvidence.reassessment: Retained after examining actual native stone-to-mithril promise,distinct price/currency rows and current item/crafting contracts. All seven conversion cases are conditional kernels; none commits a real paid conversion or supplies the required physical and downstream transaction scene. The finding concerns the bound target evidence,not a universal claim that material data cannot exist.
